title: Feature-montage: Fast-paced showcase of slicing, perfect drops, color shifts, and instant retry

clips.why: Briskly introduces the sliding cyan block and tap control.
Showcases the overhang slicing mechanic on the opening drops.
Highlights the 'PERFECT!' drop bonus and particle burst.
Speeds through rapid stacking, color-shifting blocks, and the 20-floor progress bar.
Tightens the tense wait before the narrow purple block misses.
Features streak and perfect drop tracking alongside instant retry.
Quickly shows the 45-second timer reset and dramatic early miss.
Ends on the Sky Stack app icon and INSTALL call to action.
